en.headline: Very Hot Weather and Thunderstorm Warnings in force on Monday
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Very Hot Weather Warning at 10:45 a.m. and a Thunderstorm Warning at 11:18 a.m., valid until 1:30 p.m., expecting isolated thunderstorms over the eastern New Territories.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Very Hot Weather Warning at 10:45 a.m. on Monday, warning that very hot weather was expected and urging the public to beware of heat stroke.

A Thunderstorm Warning followed at 11:18 a.m., valid until 1:30 p.m., with isolated thunderstorms forecast over the eastern New Territories. The Observatory advised people outdoors to seek safe shelter, leave the water and avoid standing on high ground or near conductive objects.

Temperatures reached around 32 degrees Celsius during the day under mainly cloudy skies with a few showers. A broad trough of low pressure was bringing unsettled conditions to the northern South China Sea and the Guangdong coast. The Observatory said showers and squally thunderstorms would continue in the next couple of days, with the chance of tropical cyclone signals remaining relatively low unless Tropical Storm Narra edges closer to the Pearl River Estuary.

zh.headline: 酷熱天氣警告及雷暴警告生效 新界東部局部有雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台上午10時45分發出酷熱天氣警告，11時18分發出雷暴警告至下午1時30分，預料新界東部有局部地區雷暴。
body: 香港天文台周一上午10時45分發出酷熱天氣警告，預料本港天氣酷熱，市民應慎防中暑。
天文台其後於上午11時18分發出雷暴警告，有效時間至下午1時30分，預料新界東部有局部地區雷暴。市民如身處室外應到安全地方躲避，離開水面，切勿站立於高地或接近導電物體。
日間氣溫約32度，大致多雲有幾陣驟雨。一道廣闊低壓槽正為南海北部及廣東沿岸帶來不穩定天氣。天文台表示未來一兩日仍有驟雨及狂風雷暴，除非熱帶風暴紫檀進一步靠近珠江口，否則需要發出熱帶氣旋警告信號的機會較低。
